2607.24063.title: The Cost of Knowing: A Resource-Aware Protocol for Benchmarking Hallucination Beyond Static Leaderboards
2607.24063.paper_summary: On standard factuality tasks, frontier models now cluster near the top of the scale. The question is therefore shifting from how factual a system is toward how much compute that factuality costs. Static leaderboards score factuality in isolation and treat compute as free, so they cannot tell a genuinely better system apart from one that simply spends more. Consider a ranking reversal. A brute-force Best-of-4 agent posts the higher raw factuality score (H-Score 0.9169 vs 0.9103) and would top a static leaderboard, but once cost is counted it is the worse system, losing on Q-Score (0.5169 vs 0.5217) at roughly four times the tokens and latency, under a reported cost weight whose sensitivity we sweep. So the system that tops a static leaderboard can be the worse one to deploy. To make this trade-off visible, we introduce MAS-HQ (Multi-Agent System Hallucination Quest), a resource-aware evaluation protocol. It wraps any factuality detector and normalizes for cost, and it pits systems against each other rather than scoring them in isolation. The Q-Score measures factuality minus normalized cost under a competitive match. Across summarization and open-domain QA, single-agent baselines drift into resource-heavy over-optimization, while competition elicits more resource-efficient policies. These gains are small but consistent, and stable across 100 trials. The axis stays discriminative for frontier systems (Gemini-2.5-Pro, and GPT-5 in simulated preview) whose raw factuality scores are already bunched near the ceiling. MAS-HQ provides a reproducible way to measure how much a factual answer costs.
2607.24063.paper_summary_zh: 在標準事實性任務中，前沿模型現在聚集在量表的頂部。問題因此從系統的事實性有多高轉向了這種事實性成本多少。靜態排行榜獨立評分事實性，並將計算視為免費，因此無法區分真正更好的系統與僅僅花費更多的系統。考慮一個排名反轉。一個暴力的最佳四選一代理商發佈了更高的原始事實性分數（H-Score 0.9169 對 0.9103），並將位於靜態排行榜的頂部，但一旦考慮成本，它就是更差的系統，在 Q-Score 上輸掉（0.5169 對 0.5217），大約花費四倍的標記和延遲，根據我們掃描的報告成本權重的敏感性。因此，位於靜態排行榜頂部的系統可能是部署上更差的系統。為了使這種權衡變得可見，我們引入了 MAS-HQ（多代理系統幻覺任務），這是一種資源感知的評估協議。它包裝任何事實性檢測器並對成本進行標準化，並使系統彼此對抗，而不是孤立地評分它們。Q-Score 測量事實性減去在競爭比賽下的標準化成本。在摘要和開放領域問答中，單代理基準漂移到資源密集型的過度優化，而競爭則引發更具資源效率的政策。這些增益雖然微小但一致，並在 100 次實驗中保持穩定。該軸對於前沿系統（Gemini-2.5-Pro 和 GPT-5 在模擬預覽中）保持區分性，其原始事實性分數已經聚集在上限附近。MAS-HQ 提供了一種可重複的方法來測量事實答案的成本。
